checks.detail: The only branch that sets effect.type = SPECIAL_EFFECT_USE is `case ITEM_ENCHANTMENT_USE_SPELL`, and it `continue`s when ench_prop[i] == 0. Every other ench_type (STAT, EQUIP_SPELL, DAMAGE, RESISTANCE, APPLY_BONUS, ...) produces stats, an EQUIP effect, or nothing. So an enchant row whose three ench_type entries contain no USE_SPELL cannot create a use sub-action.

A gem is resolved item -> gem_properties -> gem_property_data_t.enchant_id -> item_enchantment row, then passed to initialize_item_enchant with SPECIAL_EFFECT_SOURCE_GEM. A gem's use-effect question is therefore its enchant row's question.
